verdict.rationale: Marlin accepts a natural-language research topic and a brief clarifying exchange to set direction before running autonomously, which supports natural-language operation for its specific research-agent use case. However, evidence is limited to marketing copy without independent hands-on confirmation or detail on breadth of natural-language command support (e.g., mid-task steering, varied command types beyond initial topic-setting). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification, documentation of NL command flexibility beyond initial topic input, evidence of NL-based control during/after the autonomous run.
